page: Microsoft Azure E96ds_v6 is an x86_64 memory-optimized server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at 4.2 GHz. It features 96 virtual CPUs (48 physical cores with hyper-threading) and 768.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The architecture includes a massive 260 MB L3 cache and advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated matrix operations. It is equipped with 5669 GB of local storage and supports Premium Storage.

In benchmark evaluations, the E96ds_v6 demonstrates top-tier performance in memory-intensive and parallel processing workloads. Large-block uncached memory bandwidth is exceptionally strong, reaching 506.7 GB/sec for reads and 207.77 GB/sec for writes. The instance excels in Passmark database operations, scoring in the top 10%, and achieves high throughput in static web serving at 136.17 GB/sec. Multi-core CPU performance is robust, as evidenced by a strong multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 527.9 GB/sec and a Redis SET throughput of 122.52 million operations per second. Single-core performance is moderate, representing a minor tradeoff for workloads that cannot leverage parallel execution.

Given its high resource density, the E96ds_v6 offers high qualitative cost efficiency for enterprise-scale databases, large-scale in-memory caching, and data-intensive applications. The combination of 768 GB of memory, fast local storage, and AMX-driven vector execution makes it highly suitable for relational database management systems, big data analytics, and medium-scale LLM inference tasks where prompt processing speeds are critical.
